Subject: Recap and next steps: HealthSpan security discovery & IR/BCP evidence

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the procurement/security items you called out: 

- Scope: HealthSpan is evaluating Redwood for chat-driven patient support (PHI in scope) and internal knowledge search (non-PHI).
- Compliance posture questions: SOC 2 status, HIPAA/BAA, GDPR considerations for EEA users.
- Incident Response / Breach Notification: you asked for our timelines and sample evidence (IR playbook excerpt, past DR test results).
- Vendor questionnaire: you mentioned an internal security questionnaire — we can start with your spreadsheet or we can send a standard Redwood vendor Q.

Action items I propose:
1) Please send the vendor questionnaire (or we can send ours) — I'll loop in Monica and Markus to respond and provide evidence.
2) Please confirm HealthSpan's point of contact for legal/security (name/email) for BAA/data processing questions.
3) We can schedule a 30-minute security sync next week to walk through the IR timelines and evidence.

Ask: Can you share the questionnaire and any required evidence checklist by EOD Friday (2025-06-20)? That will let us prepare the SOC/IR/BCP artifacts we have for HIPAA scopes.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

Thanks Rishi — appreciated the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Compliance: HealthSpan is subject to HIPAA and we require a signed BAA for any PHI processing. We do not currently have SOC 2 Type II, but we are in the middle of a SOC 2 readiness program with an external auditor targeting Q4 2025.
- IR expectations: we typically require vendor commitments on detection/notification windows, and sample redacted post-incident reports.
- Questionnaire: attaching our vendor security spreadsheet with initial answers where available. There are a few fields we left for vendors to complete.

I've attached: HealthSpan_Vendor_Q_Responses.xlsx.

Point of contact for legal/security review: David Lee (david.lee@healthspan.com) — he is cc'd.

We can do a 30-minute sync on Tue 24 Jun or Wed 25 Jun. Which works for you?

Best,
Elena Bogdanova

Elena / David — thanks for sharing the questionnaire. I attached a short SOC 2 readiness summary and a note on our incident notification policy to help with your review. Summary below and what we can deliver immediately: 

What we can provide now (within 3 business days):
- \"RI_SOC2_Readiness_Summary.pdf\" — high level control mapping, timeline to Type II (target: Q3-Q4 2025), compensating controls and gaps remediation plan.
- Redacted IR playbook excerpt and sample incident notification timeline. See below for notification commitments.
- Excerpt from our DR runbook and date of last tabletop/failover: Full failover test: 2025-04-02 (successful). We can provide redacted test log and executive summary.

Redwood notification commitments (summary):
- Initial acknowledgement: within 4 hours of detection.
- Customer notification of confirmed breach affecting customer data: within 48 hours of confirmation.
- Detailed timeline/root cause and remediation plan: within 5 business days of confirmation (follow-ups as required).
- Full post-incident report (redacted as needed): delivered within 30 calendar days or as contractually agreed.

We can also sign a BAA for PHI processing — Markus is copied and will propose a draft. For the sync, Tue 24 Jun 10:00 AM PT works for our team. Please send calendar invite with dial-in and desired attendees.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Head of Customer Security | Redwood Inference

David / Elena — thanks, cc'ing our contracts team. Attached is a draft BAA (BAA_Draft_Redwood.docx) for your review. A few clarifications from legal: 

- We agree in principle to standard BAA language for PHI processing. Please flag any clauses that require negotiation (data location, subprocessors, audit rights).
- Notification windows in Monica's note are our standard practice; for contractual BAA obligations we typically accept a 48–72 hour window for customer notification after confirmation of a breach affecting PHI.
- If HealthSpan requires SOC 2 Type II evidence prior to go-live, we can provide the SOC 2 readiness summary plus interim evidentiary artifacts and allow for a remediation plan in the contract timeline.

Please share the appropriate legal reviewer contact at HealthSpan and I'll route our standard PO/contract packet.

Thanks,
